title: Functional Locality in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts: Empirical Laws, Self-Falsified Predictors, Fail-Closed Certificates, and Open Multi-Architecture Reproduction
description: Empirical investigation of post-hoc expert modification in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (L1 rank-dependent evacuation + FP32 gate-row mandate, L2 self-falsification + binary indicator ablation + exact finite-population permutations, L5 matched-capacity early-layer hub instability, L6 3-architecture router boundary cascades, candidate Law 7 full 3x3 cross-cartridge dominance matrix), machine-enforced JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 fail-closed certificates (7 mutation tests), and open public-model reproduction.
